meta.title: Withdraw an event that is live with two bids without a reason

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer-side project summary.
Open the published stage's Participants list to add the second bid.
Enter the second bid on behalf of another invited vendor, matching the scenario's lower bid.
Confirm the second bid was accepted.
Confirm the buyer now sees two vendor responses.
Attempt to withdraw the project without entering a withdrawal remark; the product should refuse this action.

args.text: Please enter reason for withdrawing this event

steps.note: Assert that the required-reason refusal is shown.
Confirm the failed withdrawal did not change the event's live status.
